architecture: Aly Omega V4 — Evidence-First Deep Research
design_principle: Human-locked intake, multi-source deep research, evidence-led verification, identity resolution, contradiction challenge, and final release gating.

layers.name: Human Intent
layers.role: business objective, constraints, exclusions, desired outcome

layers.name: Global Orchestrator
layers.role: task decomposition, routing, state, dependency graph

layers.name: Micro Agents
layers.role: atomic extraction, comparison, normalization, evidence mapping

layers.name: Evidence & Tool Agents
layers.role: search engines, official sites, registries, company databases, publications, documents, APIs and structured data

layers.name: Validation & Red Team
layers.role: constraint, source, identity, contradiction, risk and adversarial checks

layers.name: Learning & Memory
layers.role: feedback, error learning, memory consolidation, routing optimization

layers.name: Final Gatekeeper
layers.role: release decision, output integrity, audit trail

intake_gate.ambiguity_policy: Ask the human before search when an unresolved ambiguity can materially change the result set.

research_mode.principle: Search results are leads, never evidence.

non_negotiable_rules: No competitor or provider gap may be inferred from generic feature absence.
The system must actively search for disconfirming evidence.
Human corrections become explicit learning signals, never silent prompt mutations.
